item.title: EplayerX 1.2.43
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 更新了 EplayerX 的应用图标，并简化了人物详情页的头像样式。 - 改善了剧集片头和片尾标记的共享。共享标记现在会附带视频时长，帮助区分同一集的不同片源，减少跳到错误位置的情况。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本。请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Refreshed the EplayerX app icon and simplified the portrait styling on cast and crew pages. - Improved shared intro and credits markers. Shared markers now include the video duration, helping distinguish different cuts of the same episode and reducing skips to the wrong point.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
